'''World''' can refer to the following:

==Book and chapter titles==
* ''[[The Eye of the World]]'' - the first book of ''[[The Wheel of Time]]'' series.
* [[The Eye of the World comic|''The Eye of the World'' comic]] - a comic based on the first book of the series.
* ''[[The Dragon Reborn/Chapter 21|A World of Dreams]]'' - the twenty-first chapter of ''[[The Dragon Reborn]]''.
* ''[[Knife of Dreams/Chapter 26|As If the World Were Fog]]'' - the twenty-sixth chapter of ''[[Knife of Dreams]]''.
* ''[[Towers of Midnight/Chapter 54|The Light of the World]]'' - the fifty-fourth chapter of ''[[Towers of Midnight]]''.

==Geographical locations==
* [[Randland]] - the fan name for the world of ''[[The Wheel of Time]]''.
* [[Eye of the World]] - a location in the [[Great Blight]].
* [[Spine of the World]] - a vast mountain range spliting the [[Westlands]] and the [[Aiel Waste]].
* [[World's End]] - a location in [[Saldaea]].
* [[World Sea]] - a body of water in the [[Age of Legends]].

==Others==
* [[Breaking of the World]] - a time when male [[Aes Sedai (Age of Legends)|Aes Sedai]] destroyed much of the world due to the [[taint]] on ''[[saidin]]''.
* [[Mirror World]] - alternate realities woven by the [[Wheel of Time]].
* [[Real-world references]] - a collection of influences and references included in the series by [[Robert Jordan]].
* [[World of Dreams]] - another name for ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]''.
